entities.summary: Sergey Anatolyevich Petrov is a Russian politician and businessman who is the founder of the ROLF Group. From 2007 to 2016 — deputy of the State Duma of the V and VI convocations, he was a member of the political party Spravedlivaya Rossiya. In 2016, after the termination of his deputy powers, he returned to work in the Rolf Group of companies — he was Chairman of the Board of Directors of ROLF Group until 2019.
